description: A Flutter widget class for a payment method selection bottom sheet, providing quick access to various payment apps via deep links and handling cases where apps are not installed.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a bottom sheet with payment options such as Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Cash, allowing users to select and launch respective payment apps.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment method sheet, including UI elements and payment options.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Creates a ListTile widget for a payment option with icon, name, color, and tap behavior.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch the specified payment app via deep link; shows a snackbar if the app is not installed.
